bagPolicy.summary: Small bags are welcome, and everyone is subject to a bag check at entry. Outside food and drink, professional cameras and weapons aren't allowed.
bagPolicy.quote: Small bags are welcome. No outside food, drink, professional cameras, or weapons.

parking.summary: Free street parking is available on Minnehaha Avenue and nearby streets. The adjacent municipal lot is free evenings and weekends, and bike racks are right outside the entrance.
parking.quote: Free street parking is available along Minnehaha Avenue and the surrounding neighborhood streets.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Hook and Ladder Theater. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drink aren't allowed. A valid government-issued photo ID is required for alcohol service.
concessions.quote: No outside food, drink, professional cameras, or weapons.

accessibility.summary: All venue spaces, including The Theater, The Zen Arcade and Under The Canopy, are reachable by ramps and level entrances, with accessible restrooms on the main floor. Request ASL interpretation at least one week ahead and most other accommodations at least 72 hours ahead by calling (612) 345-7166. Service animals are welcome, but emotional support animals are not.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed with a wristband for most events. It may be restricted for sold-out shows, so check with the box office.
reEntry.quote: Re-entry is permitted with a wristband for most events.

ticketPickup.summary: All ticket sales are final, with refunds to the original payment method if a show is canceled. Most shows are all ages unless the event page says otherwise, and guests under 18 need a guardian after 9pm. A valid government-issued photo ID is required for alcohol.
ticketPickup.quote: Most shows are all-ages unless noted otherwise on the event page.

gates.summary: The main entrance is in the alley and driveway between Minnehaha Avenue and Snelling Avenue. Guests for The Theater, The Zen Arcade and Under The Canopy all enter through the central lobby.
gates.quote: The main entrance is located in the alley/driveway between Minnehaha Avenue and Snelling Avenue.
